channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Trump's approval is just 33% — but these 3 other poll numbers may worry Republicans more
item.description: The poll found that Trump's approval rating had declined from 37% in the outlets' April and July surveys. More than half of respondents, or 52%, said they strongly disapproved of his performance.

item.title: Milan protests turn violent as demonstrators clash with police over rising living costs
item.description: The unrest came a day after similar demonstrations and clashes were reported in several Italian cities, highlighting growing public discontent over the cost of living and the quality of public services

item.title: Why Trump’s 'dealmaker' image faces scrutiny as Iran, Ukraine wars test his negotiating skills
item.description: US President Donald Trump has long portrayed himself as a master dealmaker, promising to end wars and reshape global trade. However, his handling of the Iran and Ukraine conflicts, alongside tariff-driven trade tensions, has raised questions about his negotiating approach.

item.title: 'Why should the US bear the burden?': Treasury chief Bessent says Europe refused tariffs on India, China over Russia
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said European countries refused Washington's request to impose secondary tariffs on India and China for purchasing Russian oil, questioning why the United States should bear the economic burden of pressuring Moscow alone.

item.title: Meta social media platforms told to act on edited visuals, misleading claims amid SIR protests — What Govt advisory says
item.description: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), in an advisory dated October 10, asked Meta to provide adequate context for photographs, videos, graphics and other content depicting ongoing public events.

item.title: India issues fresh advisory for nationals in Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks, flight disruptions: What we know
item.description: India has issued a fresh safety advisory for its nationals in Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attack concerns. Riyadh airport remains shut, while Indian airlines have extended flight suspensions. Four injured Indians remain in ICU following an October 10 attack that killed an Indian national.

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe-led FDA cracks down on Reliance warehouse, Blinkit-linked facility; flags ‘cockroaches, spitting’
item.description: Officials found safety violations, including rodent infestations, improper storage and failure to maintain records of the disposal of expired food products.

item.title: Man sells all his belongings, travels 1,931 km to meet ‘AI girlfriend’ he wanted to marry
item.description: Edimar Martins, who had been dealing with loneliness after his mother's death, believed the woman could help him rebuild his life.

item.title: Why is France 'burning'? From student anger to nationwide unrest, is Yellow Vest movement back amid looting and clashes?
item.description: France has witnessed fresh protests over rising living costs and declining public services, with looting, arson and clashes reported across several cities. The participation of former Yellow Vest activists has raised questions about whether the movement that erupted in 2018 is making a comeback.

item.title: Balochistan unrest: Why a teacher's killing reignited outrage over Pakistan-backed 'death squads' and disappearance
item.description: The killing of Baloch schoolteacher Parvez Mazar has sparked protests in Pakistan’s Balochistan, with residents alleging state-backed ‘death squads’ were involved.

item.title: Toll plazas may give way to satellite tracking, pay by distance plan
item.description: The move could eventually allow motorists to drive without stopping at toll plazas and pay only for the distance they travel.

item.title: Canada military base fire: Deaths, injuries confirmed; cause unknown—What we know about CFB Wainwright Alberta incident
item.description: The fire broke out in the base’s training area at around 4 pm local time on October 17 and spread rapidly beyond its boundaries, according to a statement issued by Canada’s Department of National Defence on October 18.

item.title: Eight dead, 12 injured as car runs over workers in Punjab's Sangrur: What led to the accident? Details
item.description: A group of more than 20 workers enrolled under the Viksit Bharat Guarantee Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission Gramin (VB-G RAM G) were engaged in some work in the area when the incident occurred. Some of them were also reportedly sitting on the road.

item.title: Elon Musk allegedly cut ex Ashley St. Clair’s child support from $100,000 to $20,000 after she revealed their son
item.description: St. Clair alleged that after their son was born in September 2024, she was offered a lump sum of $15 million and monthly child support of $100,000 in exchange for her silence.

item.title: Who is Lawrence Bishnoi? Gangster operating from jail; linked to Salman Khan threats, now in focus for Tiger Shroff
item.description: The incident unfolded near Pushpa Park, within the jurisdiction of Juhu police station in the western suburb. A purported video circulating on social media shows a person firing at the actor and his friend.

item.title: Who is Vikas Sankrityayan, alias Vikas Pandey? He filed case against Dhruv Rathee; Delhi Court issues bailable warrants
item.description: Vikas Sankrityayan, also known as Vikas Pandey and founder of the ‘I Support NaMo’ group, filed a 2018 defamation case against Dhruv Rathee over a video alleging BJP’s IT cell tried to bribe him. A Delhi court has issued a bailable warrant against Rathee after summons remained unserved.

item.title: France protests: Trump blames immigration for unrest; 1,800 arrested, damage estimated at hundreds of millions of euros
item.description: French authorities have not established a link between immigration and the rioting. Their concerns have instead focused on violent groups, attacks on public buildings and opportunistic looting.

item.title: Why Brent crude could hit $120 amid Iran war? What it means for India as analysts warn oil prices to remain volatile
item.description: Crude oil prices are expected to remain volatile amid stalled US-Iran talks, Hormuz risks and rising tensions in West Asia. Analysts warn Brent crude could hit $120 per barrel if supply disruptions worsen. For India, higher oil prices could raise import costs, fuel prices and inflation.

item.title: Government plans to replace 1957 mining law with comprehensive new legislation
item.description: The Ministry of Mines administers the existing legislation, which serves as the principal central law governing the development and regulation of mines and minerals in India

item.title: A ₹3 cr home, ₹80 lakh in mutual funds: Why India’s wealthy are still trapped in high-stress jobs despite their assets
item.description: A viral post detailing a Delhi couple's ₹3 crore home, ₹80 lakh in mutual funds and ₹35 lakh in fixed deposits has sparked debate over EMIs, investment returns and why substantial assets may not guarantee financial independence.

item.title: See pics: Gautam Adani, wife Priti visit Shrimad Rajchandra Ashram - 'World's tallest idol was deeply moving'
item.description: Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani and Adani Foundation chairperson Dr Priti Adani visited Shrimad Rajchandra Mission Dharampur during Navratri.

item.title: NTPC targets 30 GW nuclear capacity by 2047: Water, land, seismic safety and other factors that matter in site selection
item.description: NTPC plans feasibility studies for nuclear power projects in more Indian states, including Uttar Pradesh. Assessments will consider water supply, land, population, environmental impact, transport, infrastructure, geology, costs, timelines, grid access and electricity demand.

item.title: Who is Nikhilan JM? Lovely Professional University aerospace student ranks 7th globally at WorldSkills Shanghai 2026
item.description: LPU aerospace engineering student Nikhilan J.M. secured seventh place globally in Unmanned Aerial Systems Technology at WorldSkills Shanghai 2026, competing against participants from 69 countries. He qualified after winning regional gold and IndiaSkills silver.

item.title: Jeff Bezos predicts millions will live in space by 2045, says robots will take over work on the Moon
item.description: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos expects millions of people to live in space within the next two decades, while robots take on work on the Moon and elsewhere beyond Earth. Speaking at Italian Tech Week, he linked this vision to advances in artificial intelligence, robotics and space technology.

item.title: Russian oil finding its way to the West? Indian refiners’ fuel exports to nations sanctioning Moscow jump 43%
item.description: Indian refineries in India shipped oil products to Russia-sanctioning nations in September, up 43% from August. Reliance Industries’ Jamnagar refinery accounted for six of seven cargoes unloaded at EU ports, despite the bloc’s ban on Russian crude-derived fuel imports.

item.title: ‘Pandal will collapse’: The warning that may have triggered Kolkata Durga Puja stampede that killed 19
item.description: A video of a microphone announcement warning that a north Kolkata Durga Puja pandal could collapse is being examined by police investigating the stampede that killed 19 people and injured 25.&nbsp;

item.title: Poland Investigates Suspected Violation of Its Airspace
item.description: Poland is investigating a possible violation of its airspace overnight, the Operational Command of the Armed Forces said.

item.title: FSSAI flags HUL’s ‘happy birth weight’ claim, Nestlé’s nutrition supplement over labelling concerns
item.description: India’s food regulator has issued notices to Nestle India Ltd. and Hindustan Unilever Ltd. for allegedly making misleading claims regarding nutrition supplements, extending its nationwide safety crackdown.

item.title: Mint Explainer: What’s at stake for consumer companies this festive season?
item.description: A split calendar across Q2 and Q3, coupled with rising input costs and inflation, is forcing consumer firms to absorb expenses and bet on premium demand during their biggest annual sales window.

item.title: France protests: Thousands on streets over rising living costs, poor services - Mini French Revolution? What went wrong?
item.description: Over 1,000 people were detained as protests over living costs and poor public services turned violent across France. Student anger over school conditions widened into a broader movement, drawing unions and yellow vest supporters. Macron condemned the violence and vowed punishment for those involved

item.title: Why Air India, Air India Express temporarily suspended flights to and from Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam until 24 Oct 2026
item.description: Air India and Air India Express extended their Saudi flight suspensions through 24 October 2026. Check the details. &nbsp;

item.title: Wine bottles worth ₹55 crore stolen from Italy’s Marchesi Antinori: How 7 masked men carried out 3-hour heist
item.description: Thieves reportedly stole about 30,000 premium bottles worth $5.8 million from a Marchesi Antinori logistics facility in Tuscany. Here's how it happened.

item.title: Saudi Helicopter Crashes Near Yemeni Border as Houthi War Rages
item.description: Two people died when a Saudi Arabian reconnaissance helicopter crashed near the border with war-torn Yemen, the first fatalities of their kind reported by the kingdom since the latest flare-up in its battle against Houthi rebels.

item.title: JD Vance invokes ‘I love my Indian in-laws’ after facing backlash for ‘foreign indentured servants’ remark: What he said
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance on Saturday (local time) clarified his remarks referring to H-1B visa workers as “foreign indentured servants”, saying that his rhetoric was imperfect and that he wanted to target US companies and the system, not H-1B visa holders.

item.title: CRPF mulls restoring two ranks abolished 30 years ago; here's why it is bringing lance naik, naik back
item.description: CRPF is considering restoring lance naik and naik ranks, abolished in 1997, to ease promotion delays and attract Agniveers leaving the Army. The proposal would add two promotion steps before Head Constable.
